data.product_title: Bird Feeder, Heavy Duty Metal Bird Feeders for Outdoor Hanging, Extra Large Capacity Wild Birdfeeder Lantern Shape Hold 6 LB Seed, Easy to Fill
about_product: Unique Vintage Bird Feeder: This bird feeders with a unique lantern-like design with an aged finish, a diamond-shaped mesh pattern, and a bronze surface, giving it a vintage look. It not only feeds birds but also adds a unique touch to your yard.

Extra Large Capacity: Our bird feeder size is 7"L x 7"W x 9.7"H, and can hold up to 6 pounds of bird food. The large capacity means you won't need to refill it frequently. It can hold sunflower seeds, peanuts, or mixed birdseed to attract a variety of birds.

Durable Iron Bird Feeder: Our wild bird feeder is made of high-quality iron with a copper-plated finish and a rust-resistant coating. It is corrosion-resistant, durable, and can withstand the elements outdoors.

Keep Seeds Dry: Our outdoor bird feeder has multiple drainage holes at the bottom for quick rainwater drainage. The mesh structure also maintains breathability, allowing the seeds inside the feeder to dry, making it particularly suitable for outdoor use.

Easy to Fill and Clean: Bird feeder large opening design makes it easy to add bird food, and cleaning tools can easily reach inside. The round buckle at the top secures the lid, preventing other animals from opening lid and eating the contents.

top_reviews.review_title: Beautiful way to feed the wildlife that visits my yard.
top_reviews.review_comment: I've only been feeding birds for about a year, but it's quickly become one of my favorite things to watch in the backyard. As soon as I hung this feeder in the tree, the birds found it. I ran to grab my camera and scared them off, but three of them just perched above waiting for me to leave. I've tried a few feeders and already have one similar to this style—it's my favorite—so I was excited to try this one and hoped it would be just as good. It is. The size is great. I can fill it once and it lasts several days, even with plenty of birds (and squirrels) visiting. It's easy to hang, easy to refill, and I like layering different seeds to keep all the regulars happy. Personally, I love that squirrels feed from it too and that it's large annd enough to accommodate it. It's also sturdy without being bulky. The design keeps it stable in the tree and the squirrels haven't managed to break into it. I've seen videos of them figuring out feeders, but so far these clever and adorable little guys have just been using the perches instead of getting inside. It looks great too. My other feeder has a similar weathered brushed finish and has held up really well in our very wet climate. It's round with 3 perches and this one has the same finish but a square shape with four perches, and it feels just as well made. It also feels intentional with a similar but different feeder in a neighboring tree. One feature I really like is the lid—it cinches down to stay secure, but with the push of a button it slides up for easy filling. Overall, I love this feeder. It looks great in the tree, handles the rain well, and brings a lot of life and activity to the yard. All at a decent price point!

top_reviews.review_title: Great quality, looks good and holds a LOT of seed!
top_reviews.review_comment: They really meant it with the 'heavy-duty' part in the description on this brass-looking bird feeder. It has a huge volume, easily taking on a 5lb bag of seed. It comes with all you need to hang, except a good place to watch from! Well sized and four fold-down perches available allows for a nice number and variety of birds to partake. I'm not sure how it would fair as far as squirrel proof or resistant so bear that in mind with placement, though where I have this one hanging, nothing short of Spider-squirrel will get to the seed.

top_reviews.review_title: Good quality, all metal feeder with a large capacity and 4 sided feeding
top_reviews.review_comment: This is a really nice and good quality all metal feeder. It is easy to open and load and has a sliding push plunger "lock" to keep the lid down and prevent the squirrels who will be hanging off of it from opening the lid and feasting unobstructed. Each side has a fold down metal perch that is designed for medium to smaller birds but are too close for big guys like crows to use comfortably. But if your squirrels are like mine they will be hanging down by their toes like vampire bats noshing and occasionally doing the most extreme crunch rolls up to grab another handful from the tray. The coloring of the metal is a sort of aged brass color which is attractive and weathers well. The center bottom of the feeder has a round mound to prevent the food from accumulating uneaten at the bottom and channel it to the food tray areas as the level reduces. It has tight but open mesh sides that are not lined with acrylic or glass so your seed is exposed to blowing rain which may be a concern. I would definitely use a baffle as a rain shield or something to shelter this feeder if you don't refill your feeders often to prevent finding myself with a feeder full of sprouted seed during rainy times. Reasonably priced and good metal quality that should last a long time. It is easy to clean and fill with a lid that fully opens back but can be "locked" closed.
top_reviews.review_date: Reviewed in the United States on March 16, 2026

top_reviews.review_title: Solid Metal Bird Feeder That Actually Holds Up Outdoors
top_reviews.review_comment: I have tried a handful of bird feeders over the years, and this one immediately stood out because of the construction. The metal housing feels sturdy and well built, not the thin tin style that bends or rusts after one season. It has a nice weight to it and looks good hanging outside. The mesh design works really well for attracting smaller birds while still allowing them to cling comfortably. I started seeing chickadees, finches, and a few nuthatches visiting pretty quickly once I filled it. The openings let them feed easily without dumping seed everywhere. Another thing I like is that the feeder feels durable enough to stay outside full time. Between weather, squirrels, and general wear, a lot of feeders fail quickly, but this one feels like it was designed for real outdoor use. Overall this is a simple but well made feeder that does exactly what it is supposed to do. If you want something metal, sturdy, and easy to hang that will keep birds coming back, this one has been a great addition to the yard.
